name: Hijikata Toshizo
source:
The Genbu of Earth from the realm of Chōbaku

The Vice Captain of Shinsengumi, 28 years old.
A strict, disciplined and intimidating person.
His sharp gaze gave the impression that he is unapproachable
but many are drawn to his cool charm.
There is a rumour he dissapear during full moon night.

[Translated from [url=http://www.gamecity.ne.jp/haruka-ryugu/characters/chara06_hijikatatoshizo.html]official website[/url]]
